jobs.name: 刘备
jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / production 2D full-body character animation.
Input 1 is the APPROVED ART STYLE: Chinese Three Kingdoms comic tower defense, rough confident thick black ink contour, angular adult caricature faces, hugely expressive eyebrows/eyes/mouth, earthy hand-painted color, emphatic action silhouettes. Input 2 is LIU BEI's exact identity reference. Preserve his long comic face, little black mustache and pointed goatee, high black topknot with gold tie, pale yellow-green coat with ivory collar, deep green trousers and brown gold-trim boots. Full body drawings only. NO detached body parts, NO skeletal cutouts. Simplified bold expressive animation, not anatomical realism, not round baby chibi.

Create ONE transparent RGBA sprite sheet of exactly TWELVE complete poses of this SAME Liu Bei, in an exact 4-column x 3-row grid, landscape 4:3, ideally 2048x1536. Each cell has equal square dimensions, 10% clear padding, no art crossing cell boundaries, no text or grid lines. Same figure scale and camera in every cell. For all standing poses soles on 90% of cell height, head height consistent. All poses generally face screen RIGHT except reclined lounging poses which face diagonally LEFT toward viewers in the tent. Chair exists only in cells 1 and 2 and is part of those whole-body drawings. Character, limbs and garments are fully painted connected, natural hands and five digits when visible.

Row 1, left to right:
1. IDLE A: smug relaxed Liu Bei reclining in a low simple dark wooden chaise with ochre cushion, feet visible together, left hand lazily inviting the musicians to continue. Entire chair fits this cell.
2. IDLE B: same chaise, same seat/feet/head scale and placement, Liu Bei laughing smugly with eyes closed, lazy hand gesture slightly lifted. A small alternate expression and gesture for the seated loop.
3. ALARM: upright startled full body, BOTH feet on ground, shoulders raised, hands up, huge bulging eyes and open rectangular mouth, coat lifting with surprise.
4. CARRIED A: complete Liu Bei held horizontally in midair WITHOUT any captor, head at screen RIGHT, feet at screen LEFT, abdomen centered in the cell, back slightly arched, yelling with fingers spread, knees bent. Clean complete silhouette suitable for attaching to a soldier's shoulder.

Row 2:
5. CARRIED B: same horizontal center/head location and same scale as cell 4, legs kick alternately, arms flail differently, brows scrunch, same carried direction.
6. LANDING: complete Liu Bei squatting very low with one hand braced near the ground, startled comic recoil, coat folds squash down, soles at baseline.
7. CROUCH A: low frightened crouch, hands beside cheeks, staring right, full body with both boots readable, bottom at baseline.
8. CROUCH B: same crouch proportions and position, mouth shouting, arms lifted slightly in a pleading motion, alternate expression.

Row 3:
9. STAND UP: halfway rising from crouch, knees bent, arms balancing, full body, wide worried eyes.
10. RUN A: frantic exaggerated running toward screen RIGHT, near/right leg stretched FORWARD to screen right, far/left leg bent BACK to screen left, opposite arm swing, huge terrified expression like identity reference. Ground contact at baseline.
11. RUN B: opposite running contact: near/right leg bent BACK to screen left, far/left leg stretched FORWARD to screen right, opposite arm swing, robe tails and topknot whip. This must visibly differ from cell 10 and keep identical face/clothing/scale.
12. VICTORY: both feet planted at baseline, Liu Bei exhales happily with a ridiculous relieved grin, shoulders relaxed, one hand wiping sweat from forehead.

Transparent pixels outside isolated poses; preserve alpha including spaces between fingers and legs. No background, no floor, no drop shadows, no speech bubbles, no labels, no weapons, no added characters. Match the supplied approved comic style closely, prioritizing large readable expressions and poses.
